blocks.text: A more beautiful body should also be a body you can live well in. With this vision, Marie France introduced Go Lose Pounds — the Marie France Way, its personalized, medically supervised healthy weight-management program, at an official media launch at The Conservatory of The Peninsula Manila. The name offers a knowing nod to GLP, but the program goes beyond the injection. Physician assessment, prescription treatment for qualified clients, personalized nutrition, body-composition tracking and body treatments form one coordinated plan. Medication is an option when medically appropriate, not the starting assumption for everyone. For Marie France, wanting a more beautiful body […]...
